描述_EN: the bottle is a bottle gourd form with no stopper. there is no foot and the base is unglazed with a circular indentation and ridges. it is made of porcelain, painted in underglaze blue and red. the decoration depicts a carp among waves in two bands, one on each section of the gourd, enclosed by blue lines.
描述_ZN: 该瓶为葫芦形，无盖。 没有底，底部没有上釉，有一个圆形的压痕和脊线。 它是由瓷器制成的，以釉下青花和红彩绘制。 纹饰描绘了一条鲤鱼在波浪中的样子，在葫芦的每一节上都有两条带子，用蓝色线条围起来。
